title: Minecraft-Discord ChatSync
description: It connects minecraft-discord chat. can run commands from discord to minecraft
body:
Minecraft-Discord ChatSync

Seamlessly connect your Minecraft server and Discord community in real-time!

Features:

Two-Way Chat: Sync messages between a dedicated Discord channel and your Minecraft server.
Command Execution: Run Minecraft server commands directly from Discord (with configurable permissions).
Customizable: Choose which channels sync, format messages, and set role-based access.
Lightweight & Fast: Minimal performance impact, built for efficiency.
Why Choose ChatSync?

Enhance your server’s community by bridging the gap between Minecraft and Discord. Players can stay connected without logging in, and admins can manage the server remotely. Perfect for SMPs, factions, or any server with an active Discord community.

Compatibility:

Minecraft: 1.16–1.21 (Spigot/Paper)
Discord: Works with any bot-enabled server
Easy setup with a detailed configuration guide
Get Started: Download now and check our WTF or join our WTF for help!
